verdict.rationale: Bulk public-data downloads are a fair question for a government business registry, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers online filing, payments, status tracking, certificates and downloading an image of a single filed annual report. Nothing shows bulk datasets, registry extracts or data files that avoid scraping.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
